description.en: This project shows the use of linked data to provide a way to represent and consume information about unmissing people retrieved from non-governamental organization's sites. A tool was created to mark as spam messages about unmissing people on Facebook, using a database that implements the linked data principles.

contact_point.name: Adriano Delvoux; Jairo Francisco de Souza

other_download.title: Facebook application
other_download.description: An application that consumes facebook's timeline and identifies posts about unmissing people,
